blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
We distill Kokoro-82M, a widely used open text-to-speech model with 54 voices, into Paradee, an 8.07M-parameter model that speaks one of them.
Paradee keeps Kokoro’s architecture with much narrower layers, and each of its two halves is trained separately against the frozen teacher.
It has 10 × \times fewer parameters and needs 15 × \times less compute.
We first synthesize a corpus with the teacher and keep its durations, pitch, energy and phoneme features.
We then train a small text side to predict these values, and a small decoder to turn the teacher’s saved values into the teacher’s audio, first with spectral losses and then adversarially.
Finally, we connect the two halves and quantize the weights to int8.
It needs no alignment learning and no joint training, and it runs on one laptop.
Stored in int8, Paradee is 8.5 MB, runs 25 × \times faster than real time on one CPU thread, and scores 4.41 on UTMOS against the teacher’s 4.52.
The student initially kept a slight buzz, which we trace to the phase of voiced speech between 2 and 8 kHz.
A phase-locking filter applied after synthesis removes most of it, with no training and no extra parameters.
Code, model files and audio samples are at github.com/sahilmahendrakar/paradee .

Paradee将Kokoro的建筑保存在更窄的地层上,

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Text-to-speech that runs on the device, without a server, has to be small enough to ship, fast enough to run faster than real time on a CPU, and natural enough to listen to for long stretches.
Kokoro-82M [ 11 ] is a widely used open-weight text-to-speech model with high naturalness for its size.
It is derived from StyleTTS 2 [ 31 ] and ships 54 voices, but it has 82 million parameters and needs 55 GFLOP per second of audio.
blocks.zh:
在设备上运行的文字对语音,没有服务器,必须足够小到可以发运,足够快到可以在CPU上运行比实时快,并且自然可以长时间地听.
Kokoro-82M [11]是一个被广泛使用的开口量的文字对语音模型,其大小具有较高的自然性.
它来源于StyleTTS 2 [31]和"船"54个声音,但它有8200万个参数,每秒需要55个GFLOP.

blocks.en:
Many applications only ever use one voice.
We ask how small Kokoro can get if it has to speak just one voice, and whether that can be done cheaply.
Its authors trained it with about 1,000 A100 GPU-hours [ 11 ] , whereas we want a student that can be distilled and run on one laptop.
blocks.zh:
许多应用程序只使用过一个声音.
我们问,小可口若能只说出一个声音,那么小可口可如何?
它的作者用大约1000个A100GPU小时[11]训练它,而我们希望一个学生可以被蒸馏并用一台笔记本电脑运行.

blocks.en:
Our approach follows the structure of the teacher (Figure 1 ).
Kokoro has two halves.
The text side predicts durations, pitch, energy and phoneme features, and the decoder turns them into audio.
We first run the teacher on 12,000 English sentences.
For each one we save the audio it produced along with the values it computed on the way, namely the duration of each phoneme, the pitch and energy contours, and the phoneme features passed to the decoder.
These saved outputs are the training data for both halves of the student.
blocks.zh:
我们的做法遵循教师的结构(图1)。
克克多罗有两半.
文本侧会预测持续时间,发音,能量和电话等功能,解码器会把它们变成音频.
我们先用12,000个英文句子管理老师
对于每一个,我们保存它产生的音频 连同它在路上计算出的值, 即每个电话的长度, 投影和能量轮廓, 电话功能传递给解码器。
这些节省的产出是两个学生的一半的培训数据。

blocks.en:
We then shrink each half and train it separately against the teacher, which stays frozen, meaning its weights are never updated and it only supplies targets.
The student text side reads the phonemes and learns to predict the teacher’s saved durations, pitch, energy and phoneme features.
The student decoder is given the teacher’s saved durations, pitch, energy and phoneme features as input and learns to reproduce the teacher’s saved audio from them.
Because each half trains against fixed teacher outputs, no alignment has to be learned.
blocks.zh:
然后我们收缩每半,单独训练 与老师对抗, 老师保持冷冻, 这意味着它的重量从来没有更新, 它只供应目标。
学生的文字边阅读电话,并学会预测老师节省的时间、投球、能量和电话功能。
学生的解码器被赋予教师节省的时间、投球、能量和电话功能,作为投入,并学会复制教师从中保存的音频。
因为每个半个列车都与固定的教师产出相抗衡,所以无需学习校正.

blocks.en:
To join them, we connect the student text side’s outputs to the student decoder’s inputs.
At inference the text side reads the phonemes and predicts a duration for each one.
These durations stretch its phoneme features to one per audio frame, and it then predicts pitch and energy for every frame.
The decoder turns these into audio, and nothing is retrained after the halves are joined.
Last, we quantize the weights to 8-bit integers, which makes the model four times smaller with no measurable change in UTMOS.

校对:Soup

这些持续时间将其电话功能延伸至每个音频帧一个,然后预测每个帧的发音和能量.
解码器将这些都变成音频,半音合为一体后没有任何内容被重新训练.
最后,我们把权重量化为8位整数,这使得模型变小了4倍而UTMOS没有可测量的变化.

The result, Paradee, has 8.07M parameters (10 × \times fewer than the teacher’s 81.8M) and needs 15 × \times less compute.
Stored in int8, it is 8.5 MB, runs 25 × \times faster than real time on one CPU thread, and scores 4.41 on UTMOS [ 44 ] against the teacher’s 4.52.

blocks.en: Our contributions are: 1. A simple single-voice distillation method (Section 4 ). Each half is distilled separately against the frozen teacher and the halves are joined without joint training. It needs no alignment learning and no teacher at inference time, and it trains on one laptop. 2. What we learn from distilling the halves separately (Section 6 ). Pairing each student half with the other half of the teacher shows what each one costs. A 4.2M text side scores UTMOS 4.36 through the teacher’s decoder, and a 7.1M one does no better. The 3.9M decoder scores 4.37 from the teacher’s text side. Together the two halves score 4.39, so their errors do not add up. For the decoder, the balance of the training losses matters more than its size. Lowering the weight of the spectral loss so that the adversarial critics could take effect raised UTMOS from 3.0 to 4.4, while making the decoder wider or twice as large did not help. Finally, the text side must be trained to match the teacher’s durations, pitch, energy and phoneme features directly. A text side trained instead to make the teacher’s decoder sound good reached the teacher’s own score with that decoder, but fell to 3.78 with the student decoder, against 4.39 for the directly trained one. 3. A map of where Kokoro spends its parameters and compute (Section 3 ). The waveform generator is a quarter of the parameters but 89% of the compute, and the small text side is the part most sensitive to quantization. 4. A diagnosis and fix for the student’s residual buzz (Section 7 ). Listening tests place it in the phase of voiced speech between 2 and 8 kHz, just above where Kokoro’s harmonic excitation stops, and a training-free phase-locking filter removes most of it.

blocks.en: 2 Background
blocks.zh: 2 背景情况

blocks.en:
Kokoro follows the StyleTTS 2 design [ 31 , 28 ] .
Text is converted to phonemes, and the model then works in two halves (Figure 1 , top), both of which receive a style vector that selects the voice.
blocks.zh:
Kokoro遵循StyleTTS 2设计[31,28].
文本被转换为通电话,而后该模型以两个半部分(图1,顶部)工作,两者都得到选择语音的样式向量.

blocks.en:
The text side decides what to say and how.
A phoneme-level BERT [ 30 ] with the ALBERT architecture [ 25 ] reads the phonemes, and a prosody predictor turns them into a duration for each phoneme, a pitch contour (F0) and an energy contour.
A separate text encoder produces 512-channel features that describe the sound of each phoneme (we call them the phoneme features ).
After they are stretched by the durations, they are passed to the decoder.
blocks.zh:
文本一方决定如何说话以及如何说话。
带有ALBERT架构的电话-me-level BERT [30] 读取了这些电话,一个prosody的预测器将它们变成每个电话的长度,一个发音轮廓(F0)和一个能量轮廓.
一个单独的文本编码器会产生512个通道特性来描述每个电话me的声音(我们称之为"电话"特性.
在被持续时间拉长后,它们被传递到解码器.

blocks.en:
The acoustic side , or decoder, decides what the waveform looks like.
It works in two stages.
First, a stack of residual convolutional blocks with adaptive instance normalization (AdaIN) [ 14 ] combines the phoneme features with the pitch and energy contours, conditioned on the style vector.
These blocks account for 41% of Kokoro’s parameters.
Then a waveform generator, an iSTFTNet [ 16 ] built on HiFi-GAN [ 22 ] , turns the result into audio at 24 kHz.
To help it produce voiced sounds, the generator is also given a tone computed from the predicted pitch, made of sine waves at the pitch and its first eight overtones [ 49 ] .
blocks.zh:
声边,或解码器,决定波形是什么样子.
它分两个阶段运作.
首先,一叠带有适应性实例正常化(AdaIN) [14] 的剩余回旋区块结合了电话特性与发球和能量轮廓,以样式向量为条件.
这些区块占科克罗参数的41%.
然后一个波形生成器,一个基于HiFi-GAN [22]的iSTFTNet [16],将结果在24 kHz转换成音频.
为了帮助它产生发音,发电机还得到一个从预测的投出出出声调,由投出声调的正弦波和它的前八起出声[49].

blocks.en: 3 Analysis of the teacher
blocks.zh: 3 对教师的分析

blocks.en:
Before training anything, we measured how Kokoro’s parameters and compute are divided among its parts and how sensitive each part is to quantization.
These decide which part must shrink most.
All measurements use Kokoro-82M v1.0 with voice af_heart on an Apple M4 Pro.
blocks.zh:
在训练之前,我们测量了 Kokoro 的参数和计算 如何在它的各个部分之间划分,以及每个部分如何敏感地量化。
这些决定了哪部分必须缩小最大。
所有测量都使用Kokoro-82M v1.0在苹果M4 Pro上配有语音af_heart.

blocks.en:
Figure 2 and Table 1 split the model into three parts.
The text side holds 35% of the parameters, the decoder’s AdaIN blocks 41% and the generator 24%.
The compute is split very differently.
The generator performs 89% of the 55 GFLOP needed per second of audio, because its last stages run convolutions at 60 × \times the frame rate.
The text side is under 10%.
So on a CPU, run time is dominated by the generator’s per-sample convolutions, not by the parameter count.
Any large speed-up therefore has to come from shrinking the generator, whatever happens to the text side.
blocks.zh:
图2和表1将模型分为三部分。
文本方持有35%的参数,解码器的AdaIN区块占41%,生成器占24%。
计算法的划分非常不同.
生成器完成每秒需要的55个GFLOP的89%,因为其末级会以60×x相机速率的相机转动.
文本面低于10%。
因此,在CPU上,运行时间以生成器的每个样本的演化为主,而不是以参数计数为主.
因此,无论文本方面发生什么情况,任何大型加速都必须来自生成器的收缩。

blocks.en: 4 Method
blocks.zh: 4 方法

blocks.en: 4.1 Single-voice specialization
blocks.zh: 4.1 单一语音专业

blocks.en:
Paradee is trained for a single voice, af_heart .
Because the voice is fixed, we remove the style input from both halves of the student and replace it with a learned constant vector.
In Kokoro, the style vector for a given voice also changes with the length of the utterance, so the student has to learn this dependence on length from the training data.
blocks.zh:
游行训练为单声道, af_heart.
因为声音是固定的,所以我们从学生的两半中去掉风格输入,取而代之的是学习到的常向量.
在科克罗语中,给定语音的样式矢量也会随着语音的长度而变化,因此学生必须从训练数据中学习这种对长度的依赖.

blocks.en: 4.2 Teacher corpus
blocks.zh: 4.2 (中文(简体) ). 教师

blocks.en:
We synthesized 12,000 English sentences from WikiText-103 [ 35 ] with the teacher, 23.9 hours of audio.
For every sentence we stored the phonemes, the predicted durations, F0 and energy contours, the phoneme features and the waveform (6.9 GB).
Waveforms were generated on CPU with a fixed seed per sentence so the excitation can be reproduced exactly, since Kokoro’s output differs slightly between CPU and GPU.
The first 200 sentences are held out for evaluation.
blocks.zh:
我们从维基文库中合成了12,000个英语句子 从WikiText-103 [35] 与老师,23.9小时的音频.
每句我们存储的电话,预测持续时间,F0和能量轮廓,电话的特性和波形(6.9 GB).
在CPU上生成了波形,每句有固定的种子,这样就可以确切地再现激出,因为Kokoro的输出在CPU和GPU之间略有不同.
初二百句出为正评.

blocks.en: 4.3 Student architecture
blocks.zh: 4.3 学生建筑

blocks.en: Each student half is Kokoro’s own code with smaller widths, so every student layer has a teacher counterpart to learn from.
blocks.zh: 每个学生的一半是科克罗自己的代码,宽度较小,因此每个学生层都有教师对应的学习对象.

blocks.en:
It has an ALBERT with 256 hidden units, 6 layers and 4 heads, and a prosody predictor and text encoder with 192 channels and 3 layers.
A 2-layer MLP projects the 192-channel text features up to the 512 channels the decoder expects.
We also trained a variant with a linear projection (4.0M) and a wider one (7.1M).
blocks.zh:
它有一个有256个隐藏单元,6层和4个头的ALBERT,以及一个有192个通道和3个地层的活化预测器和文本编码器.

blocks.en:
The decoder keeps Kokoro’s layout, with 256 channels in the AdaIN blocks instead of 1,024 and 128 in the generator instead of 512.
It also keeps Kokoro’s upsampling factors, kernel sizes (3, 7, 11), excitation module and iSTFT head.
The whole decoder needs 3.36 GFLOP per second of audio, 15 × \times less than the teacher’s decoder, and its generator has 1.19M parameters.
Table 8 in the appendix lists the other sizes we built.
blocks.zh:
解码器保持了科克罗的布局,AdaIN区块有256个频道,而不是发电机有1024个频道和128个频道,而不是512个频道.
这也保留了克克洛的上标因子,内核大小(3,7,11),引出模块和iSTFT头.
整个解码器每秒需要3.36 GFLOP的音频,比老师的解码器还少出15×分相,其生成器有1.19M参数.
附录中的表8列出了我们建造的其他尺寸。

blocks.en: 4.4 Training
blocks.zh: 4.4 培训

blocks.en:
The student reads phonemes and is trained, with the teacher’s durations given (teacher forcing), to predict the teacher’s log durations, pitch, energy and phoneme features with L1 losses.
We train it for 8,000 steps at batch size 32 with AdamW and a learning rate of 5 × 10 − 4 5\times 10^{-4} .
blocks.zh:
学生读取电话,经过培训(教师强迫),可以预测教师的日志持续时间、投球、能量和电话功能以及L1损失。
我们训练它8000步的分批大小为32, 与亚当W, 学习率5×10−4 5\Times 10×4}。

blocks.en:
The student decoder is fed the teacher’s own phoneme features, pitch and energy and trained to reproduce the teacher’s waveform on 1.6 s segments.
Stage one uses only spectral losses, which compare how loud each frequency is over time in the student’s audio and the teacher’s, ignoring phase.
The first is a log-mel L1 loss, which compares spectrograms on the mel scale, a frequency scale spaced the way human hearing works.
The second is a multi-resolution STFT loss [ 50 ] , which compares ordinary spectrograms at three resolutions (FFT sizes 512, 1024 and 2048).
Stage one runs for 50,000 steps at batch size 16 and a learning rate of 2 × 10 − 4 2\times 10^{-4} .
Stage two adds HiFi-GAN-style adversarial training [ 22 ] , in which small discriminator networks learn to tell the student’s audio from the teacher’s and the student learns to fool them.
We use a multi-period discriminator (periods 2, 3, 5, 7 and 11) and a multi-resolution spectrogram discriminator [ 15 ] , 3.2M parameters together, with least-squares GAN losses and feature matching, at batch size 8.
We ran 5,000 steps with the spectral losses weighted 10 times the adversarial loss, then 5,000 more with them weighted 3 times.
blocks.zh:
学生的解码器被喂入教师自己的电话功能、发音和能量,并接受培训,以在1.6个部分复制教师的波形。
第一阶段只使用光谱损失,它比较了每个频率在学生的音频和老师的音频中随着时间推移而产生多大的声响,忽略了阶段.
第一种是log-mel L1损失,它比较了mel尺度上的分光克,一个频率尺度为人类听力工作方式的间隔.
二是多分辨率STFT损失[50],以三个分辨率(FFT大小为512,1024和2048)来比较普通分光谱.
第一阶段为5万步,分批16步,学习速度为2×10−4 2.\times 10×4}。
第二阶段增加了HiFi-GAN式的对抗性训练[22],在这种训练中,小歧视者网络学习从老师那里告诉学生的音响,学生学习欺骗他们.

blocks.en:
Every weight matrix is quantized to int8 per output channel with an fp16 scale, and all other parameters are kept in fp16.

blocks.en: 5 Experimental setup
blocks.zh: 5 实验设置

blocks.en:
DTW log-mel L1 compares the spectrogram of a rendition with the teacher’s after aligning the two in time with dynamic time warping (DTW), which locally stretches or compresses one of them so that matching sounds line up.
A rendition that is slightly faster or slower is therefore not penalized for timing alone.
It is good for teacher-forced comparisons where timing is fixed, but it saturates for free-running students, whose valid prosody differs from the teacher’s (a 3% speed change alone scores 0.36). UTMOS [ 44 ] is a neural network trained on human ratings to predict the mean opinion score (MOS) that listeners would give a clip for naturalness, on a scale from 1 (bad) to 5 (excellent).
We use its utmos22_strong checkpoint, and it is our main metric for comparing free-running students.
All UTMOS scores are averages over the 200 held-out sentences.
The 95% confidence interval of the mean is ± 0.003 \pm 0.003 for the teacher and between ± 0.01 \pm 0.01 and ± 0.04 \pm 0.04 for the students. Word error rate (WER) comes from transcribing the audio with Whisper (base) and comparing it with the source text.
It measures intelligibility, and it barely separates our models, so we report it only for the main result. Speaker similarity is the cosine between Resemblyzer speaker embeddings [ 43 ] of a system’s utterance and the teacher’s utterance of the same sentence.
We also compared samples by listening throughout, which the author did informally.
blocks.zh:
DTW log-mel L1 在及时将两者与动态时间扭曲(DTW)对齐后, 将移植的光谱图与老师的光谱图进行比较,
因此,略快或较慢的引渡不会仅仅因时间而受到惩罚。
时间固定时段的教师强制比较是好的,但对自由跑的学生来说是饱和的,他们的有效音速与教师不同(单是3%的速度变化得分0.36分). UTMOS [44]是一个接受过人类评级培训的神经网络,用来预测听众会给出自然性片段的平均值评分(MOS),比例从1(差)到5(优秀).
我们使用它的Utmos22_强检点,这是比较自由跑学生的主要衡量标准.
所有UTMOS的分数都是平均超过200个被搁置的句子.
平均值的95%置信间隔为教师±0.003\pm0.003,学生为±0.01\pm0.01到±0.04\pm0.04. 单词出错率(WER)出自将音频与Whisper (base)转录并和源文本作比较.
它测量了知觉,它几乎不分开我们的模型,所以我们只报告主要结果. 演讲者相似之处在于Resemblyzer演讲者嵌入一个系统的[43] 语句与老师的同句相通。
我们还通过全程监听来比较样本,作者对此进行了非正式的比较.

blocks.en:
All training ran on one MacBook Pro (Apple M4 Pro, 24 GB) using the MPS backend.
Speed is measured on the same machine on one CPU thread, over 8 held-out sentences (about 61 seconds of audio), excluding grapheme-to-phoneme conversion for both models.

速度在一个CPU线上在同一台机器上被测出,超过8个被扣出句子(约61秒音频),不包括两个模型的石墨到手机转换.

A small model has no redundant channels left to absorb the rounding.

blocks.en: 6.2 Text-side students
blocks.zh: 6.2 文本侧学生

The teacher row’s DTW is the teacher against a second run of itself with a different random seed. The last row adds a log-mel loss on audio produced by passing the student’s outputs through the frozen teacher decoder. It has the worst DTW but the best UTMOS, because it learns prosody that sounds natural but differs from the teacher’s rendition.

blocks.en: We first tested each student text side by plugging it into the frozen teacher decoder (Table 4 ).
blocks.zh: 我们首先测试每个学生的文字,

blocks.en:
Growing the text side from 4.2M to 7.1M improved every teacher-forced loss slightly but left the free-running result unchanged (DTW 0.91 against 0.89, UTMOS 4.36 against 4.35).
The remaining gap is set by the training objective, not capacity.
blocks.zh:
文字方面从4.2M增长到7.1M,使每个教师造成的损失都略有改善,但自由运行的结果保持不变(DTW 0.91对0.89,UTMOS 4.36对4.35)。
其余差距由培训目标确定,而不是由能力确定。

blocks.en:
The teacher’s 512 phoneme-feature channels are highly redundant.
About 190 dimensions hold 90% of their variance and 430 hold 99%.
A student with 192 channels and a linear projection can express at most 192 of those dimensions, and it came close to the best error any such projection allows (0.079 against 0.068), so the projection, not the student, was the limit.
Replacing the linear projection with a small two-layer network (an MLP) removed this limit.
Its error fell to 0.066, below what any linear projection can reach, and UTMOS rose from 4.15 to 4.36.
To see where the remaining error comes from, we took one kind of output at a time from the student and the rest from the teacher, and measured the distance to the teacher’s audio on 8 held-out sentences.
Compared with the teacher’s own floor of 0.12, student phoneme features add about 0.47, student pitch and energy about 0.35, and student durations only about 0.13.
blocks.zh:
教师的512个电话网络频道非常冗余。
大约190个维相差90%,430个维相差99%。
拥有192个信道和线性投影的学生最多能表达出192个这些维度,并且接近任何这种投影允许的最佳错误(0.079对0.068),因此投影而不是学生是极限.
用一个小的双层网络(一个MLP)来取代线性投影,取消了这个限制.
它的误差下降到了0.066,低于任何线性预测所能达到的水平,而UTMOS从4.15升至4.36.
看看剩下的错误来自何处,我们一次从学生那里取出一种输出,其余的则从教师那里取出,在8个被搁置的句子上测量了与教师的音频的距离.
与老师自己的楼层0.12相比,学生的电话功能增加了大约0.47个,学生的投球和能量大约0.35个,学生的工龄只有大约0.13个.

blocks.en:
We also tried giving the text side one more training objective.
Its predictions are passed through the frozen teacher decoder, and the resulting audio is compared with the teacher’s recording using a log-mel loss.
This lifted the 4.2M text side to the teacher’s own score (4.52).
But those features were specialized to the teacher’s decoder.
Connected to Paradee’s student decoder, they scored 3.78, while the text side trained on the teacher’s values directly scored 4.39 with the same decoder.
Features learned by matching the teacher’s features transfer to a new decoder, and features learned by pleasing one particular decoder do not.
Paradee therefore uses the feature-supervised text side.
blocks.zh:
我们还试图给文本侧增加一个培训目标。
其预测通过被冷冻的教师解码器传递,产生的音效被与教师使用"log-mel"损失来作比较.
这解除了4.2M文本的侧面到老师自己的分数(4.52)。
但这些特征是教师的解码器专用的。
与"游行"的学生解码器相接,他们得分为3.78分,而文字方面则以相同的解码器直接接受教师值的训练.
通过将老师的特征与新的解码器相匹配而获得的特征,而通过取悦某个特定的解码器而获得的特征则并非如此。
因此"游行"使用由特征监督的文本侧面.

blocks.en: 6.3 Decoder students
blocks.zh: 6.3 解码学生

blocks.en: Table 5: UTMOS of the student decoder (driven by the teacher’s text side) and of the full student, over 200 held-out sentences. The teacher scores 4.52.
blocks.zh: 表5:学生解码器的UTMOS(由老师的文本方驱动)和学生全员的UTMOS,200多句被搁置. 师得分4.52.

blocks.en:
With spectral losses alone the small decoder converged to a DTW distance of 0.50 but scored only 2.98 on UTMOS (Table 5 ).
At this point the full student sounds like the af_heart voice with a second, robotic voice speaking at the same time.
Spectrograms show why.
The student keeps crisp harmonic stripes up to 6–8 kHz, whereas the teacher’s harmonics dissolve into breathy noise above 3–4 kHz, so the sine excitation leaks through almost unchanged.
Level, frequency balance and silence were all correct.
blocks.zh:
光谱损失单是小解码器就汇合到DTW相距0.50,但在UTMOS上只得2.98分(表5)。
此时全学生听起来就像一个有第二个机器人声音的Af_heart声音同时发声.
分相能显所由.
学生将口琴条纹一直保持到6-8千赫,而老师的口琴则溶入了3-4千赫以上的呼吸噪声,因此正弦出声几乎没有改变。
水平、频率平衡和沉默都是正确的。

blocks.en:
Adversarial training fixes most of this, but only once the critics are allowed to matter.
With HiFi-GAN’s default spectral weight of 45, the spectral term outweighed the adversarial terms about 15 to 1, and UTMOS barely moved in 3,000 steps (2.98 to 3.02).
Lowering the weight to 10 and then 3 raised the decoder to 4.37 and the full student to 4.39.
The phase-locking filter adds little to UTMOS (4.39 to 4.41) but is what removes most of the audible buzz (Section 7 ).
blocks.zh:
反常的训练解决了大部分问题,但只有在批评者被允许重要的时候.
由于HiFi-GAN的默认光谱重量为45,光谱名词超过了约15到1的对抗名词,UTMOS在3000步(2.98到3.02步)中几乎没有移动.
将分量降低到10分后再提高到3分将解码器提升到4.37分,将全学生提升到4.39分.
相锁滤波器对UTMOS(4.39至4.41)几乎没有增加,但正是它去除了大部分可听取的叫声(第7节)。

blocks.en:
With spectral-only decoders, the student text side through the teacher decoder scored 0.87 on DTW, the teacher text side through the student decoder 0.50, and the full student 0.81, better than the text side alone.
The teacher decoder, trained on exact features, amplifies small feature errors.
The student decoder, trained on audio, is more forgiving.
Measuring each half against the other teacher half therefore overstates what the combination loses, and we did not need joint training.
The final models show the same on UTMOS.
The student text side through the teacher decoder scores 4.36 and the teacher text side through the student decoder 4.37, each about 0.15 below the teacher, yet the full student scores 4.39 before the filter.
blocks.zh:
有光谱专用解码器,学生文本侧通过教师解码器在DTW上得分为0.87分,教师文本侧通过学生解码器0.50分,学生全能0.81分,优于文本侧单独.
教师解码器,经过精确特征的培训,放大了小特征错误.
学生解码器,接受音频训练,更能宽恕.
因此,用一半来衡量另一半的教师,就过分夸大了组合的损失,我们不需要联合培训。
最终的模型在UTMOS上显示相同.
学生文本侧通过教师解码器得分为4.36分,教师文本侧通过学生解码器4.37分,每分在教师下方约0.15分,然而完全学生在过滤器前得分为4.39分.

blocks.en: 7 Residual buzz and the phase-locking filter
blocks.zh: 7 余发和相锁过滤器

blocks.en:
After adversarial training, the student’s one audible flaw was a slight buzz on voiced sounds.
To locate it, we combined the magnitude of the student’s spectrogram with the teacher’s phase, and the reverse, using identical excitation.
The student’s magnitude with the teacher’s phase had no audible buzz (UTMOS 4.49, against 4.37 for the student and 4.52 for the teacher), while the teacher’s magnitude with the student’s phase still buzzed (4.45).
Swapping in the teacher’s phase only between 2 and 8 kHz was enough to remove it.
This band starts just above the reach of the excitation tone, whose 9 harmonics end near 1.9 kHz for this voice.
Above that frequency the generator has to synthesize the harmonics itself, and the small student gets their timing slightly wrong.

blocks.en:
Changes to training did not remove the buzz.
Wider critics, direct waveform and phase losses, distilling the teacher’s final layer, and larger decoders all left it audible.
blocks.zh:
培训的更改没有去掉音响。
广大的批评家,直接的波形和相相损,蒸馏出老师最后的一层,更大的解码器都让它听不见.

blocks.en:
We therefore correct the phase after synthesis instead, through a phase-locking filter.
The decoder already produces its own excitation tone, whose harmonics have steady phase.
In voiced frames and in the 2–8 kHz band, the filter measures how far the output’s phase drifts from this tone, smooths that drift over about a third of a second, and resynthesizes the audio with the smoothed phase and the original magnitude.
The idea is close to identity phase locking in the phase vocoder [ 26 ] .
The filter has no parameters and takes about 5% of Paradee’s run time.
By ear, it removes most of the buzz.
A slight buzz remains on some stressed syllables, where the student is 3–6 dB quieter than the teacher between 2 and 8 kHz, which no phase correction can fix.
UTMOS barely registers the change (4.39 to 4.41), and it did not track this artifact reliably elsewhere either, rating a larger decoder 0.5 lower than one that sounded the same by ear.
For this artifact we therefore relied on listening.

因此,我们依赖倾听。

blocks.en: 8 Related work
blocks.zh: 8 相关工作

blocks.en:
Kokoro-82M [ 11 ] uses the StyleTTS 2 architecture [ 31 ] without its diffusion and encoder parts.
StyleTTS 2 builds on StyleTTS [ 28 ] , which introduced the style-conditioned duration, pitch and energy predictor that Paradee’s text side imitates, and on PL-BERT [ 30 ] , a phoneme-level ALBERT [ 25 ] .
The decoder is an iSTFTNet [ 16 ] , a HiFi-GAN [ 22 ] whose last layers are replaced by a small inverse STFT, with Snake activations from BigVGAN [ 27 ] and a harmonic sine excitation from the neural source-filter family [ 49 , 48 ] .
HiFTNet [ 29 ] combines the same two ideas as a standalone vocoder.
The hn-NSF model [ 48 ] learns a maximum voiced frequency above which the excitation is noise, which is directly relevant to our finding that the student’s defect begins where Kokoro’s fixed 9-harmonic excitation ends.
blocks.zh:
Kokoro-82M [11] 使用 StyleTTS 2 架构 [31] 没有其扩散和编码器部件.
StyleTTS 2以StyleTTS [28] 为基础,其中引入了由"游行者"的文字侧面模仿的风格条件持续时间,投出和能量预测器,并基于PL-BERT [30],一个电话-级别ALBERT [25].
解码器是一款iSTFTNet [16],是一款HiFi-GAN [22],其上一层被小反相取而代之的STFT,由BigVGAN [27]出自蛇活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活
HiFTNet [29] 结合了与独立vocoder相同的两个想法.
hn-NSF模型[48] 学习了最大表达频率,上面的激发是噪声,这与我们的结论直接相关,即学生的缺陷起源于Kokoro固定的9-谐调激发结束的地方.

blocks.en:
Knowledge distillation [ 12 ] entered TTS through FastSpeech [ 41 ] , which takes durations from an autoregressive teacher and trains on its outputs, and FastSpeech 2 [ 42 ] , which adds explicit pitch and energy predictors.
Paradee’s text side is supervised the same way, but also on the teacher’s phoneme features.
LightSpeech [ 33 ] profiled FastSpeech’s components before compressing it 15 × \times , a precedent for our census.
Lai et al. [ 24 ] studied how pruning TTS models and vocoders affects naturalness, intelligibility and prosody.
Vocoder distillation dates to Parallel WaveNet [ 47 ] .
More recently, Du et al. [ 9 ] distilled a teacher’s intermediate features into an amplitude-and-phase iSTFT vocoder, whereas distilling the teacher’s iSTFT head did not help us (Section 7 ).
StyleTTS-ZS [ 32 ] “distills” within the StyleTTS family, but it distills the diffusion sampler, not the model size.
blocks.zh:
知识分馏[12]通过FastSpeech[41]输入TTS,这需要一位自相递进的教师和关于其输出的列车持续时间,而FastSpeech 2[42]则增加了明确的投出和能预测器.
校对:Soup
LightSpeech [33] 在压缩FastSpeech的组件之前,
赖等. [24] 研究了Pruning TTS模型和vocoders如何影响自然,知能和活泼.
Vocoder蒸馏日期至平行波网 [47].
最近,杜等编著. [9] 将教师的中间特征蒸馏成振幅相和相相的iSTFT vocoder,而将教师的iSTFT头蒸馏对我们没有帮助(第7节)。
StyleTTS-ZS [32] 在StyleTTS家族内的"distills",但它提炼出扩散样品,而不是模型大小.

blocks.en:
The closest published work is Nix-TTS [ 6 ] , which distills VITS [ 20 ] module by module into a 5.23M student that runs 3 × \times faster on CPU.
sanoTTS [ 46 ] distills VITS voices from Piper into students under 2M parameters for microcontrollers, and notes that aggregate quality predictors missed a sibilant failure.
Both distill a VITS teacher, whose decoder is a HiFi-GAN without a harmonic source, and neither studies the excitation or phase effects we report.
blocks.zh:
最接近出版的作品是Nix-TTS [6],它通过模块将VITS [20]模块分馏成一个5.23M的学生,在CPU上运行速度快于3×\时.
sanoTTS [46] 从Piper将VITS的声音分馏到微控制器的2M参数下的学生中,并注意集合质量预测器错过了一次偏斜故障.
两人都蒸馏出一个VITS老师,他的解码器是没有口琴源的HiFi-GAN,并且都没有研究我们报告的激出或相位效应.

blocks.en:
We know of no paper that distills Kokoro or StyleTTS 2 into a small model.
Pipatanakul et al. [ 40 ] train a full-size Kokoro as a single-voice Thai student on synthetic speech, so there Kokoro is the student and is not compressed.
The closest work is an unpublished model, Kokoro-7M-Distill [ 36 ] , released on Hugging Face in September 2026 while this work was under way.
It is a 7.48M single-voice English student of Kokoro-82M with the same broad shape as Paradee.
It uses teacher durations, a narrowed decoder, multi-resolution STFT and log-mel losses, multi-period and multi-resolution critics, and a WavLM feature-matching term [ 5 ] .
Its training notes report UTMOS 4.14 and observe that without the WavLM term the output “stays subtly robotic”, which may be the artifact we analyze.
The two efforts are independent.
Paradee differs in supervising the teacher’s internal pitch, energy and phoneme features and in training the two halves separately.
It also adds an analysis of the teacher’s parameters, compute and quantization sensitivity and the localization of the residual artifact.
On our 200 held-out sentences, with its matching voice pack, it scores UTMOS 4.18 against Paradee’s 4.41 and runs about 1.4 times as fast (Table 3 ).
blocks.zh:
我们知道没有纸能把克克洛或StyleTTS 2 分解成一个小模型。
Pipatanakul等人 [40] 训练一款全尺寸的克克洛作为单声道 泰语学生在合成演讲,所以有克克洛是学生,没有被压缩.
相距最近的作品是未出版的模型"克克洛-7-M-Distill [36]",在2026年9月此作进行期间于Hugging Face上发行.
是Kokoro-82M的7.48M单声道英语学生,外形与Paradee相同.
它使用教师持续时间,一个收缩的解码器,多分辨率的STFT和log-mel损失,多周期和多分辨率的批评者,以及WavLM特征比对术语 [5].
它的训练说明报告了UTMOS 4.14, 并观察到,没有WavLM术语,输出“停留在潜机器人上”,这可能是我们分析的文物。
这两项努力是独立的。
游行在监督教师的内部投球、能量和电话功能以及分别培训两者方面有所不同。
它还增加了对教师参数、计算和量化敏感性以及剩余文物本地化的分析。

blocks.en:
Piper [ 10 ] ships per-voice VITS models and is the usual local baseline.
KittenTTS [ 21 ] credits the StyleTTS 2 architecture.
Its smallest model has 14M parameters and eight voices, and it is not described as distilled.
SupertonicTTS [ 19 ] is an efficient 44M flow-matching system trained from scratch.
MB-iSTFT-VITS [ 18 ] makes an end-to-end model light by using a multi-band iSTFT decoder.
For Kokoro itself, community int8 ONNX exports [ 38 ] are about 86–92 MB, against Paradee’s 8.45 MB.
blocks.zh:
Piper [10] 舰船每发VITS型号,是当地常用的基准.
KittenTTS [21] 贷记StyleTTS 2架构.
其最小的模型有14M参数和8个声音,没有被描述为被蒸馏.
SupertonicTTS [19] 是从零开始训练的高效的44M相接相接系统.
MB-iSTFT-VITS [18] 通过多波段的iSTFT解码器来制作端到端模型光.
对于Kokoro本身来说,社区int8 ONNX出口[38]大约是86-92 MB,而Paradee的为8.45 MB。

blocks.en:
Vocos [ 45 ] predicts a full-resolution spectrum and phase at frame rate and inverts it with one iSTFT, and iSTFTNet2 [ 17 ] and WaveNeXt [ 37 ] push the same direction.
APNet and APNet2 [ 2 , 8 ] and FreeV [ 34 ] predict amplitude and phase explicitly, and use anti-wrapping phase losses [ 1 ] that handle the ± π \pm\pi wrap-around of phase.
Wavehax [ 51 ] argues that time-frequency vocoders lack a harmonic prior and adds one, which matches our diagnosis that the small decoder fails exactly where the harmonic prior stops.
The perceptual importance of phase in speech is well established [ 39 ] , and loss of phase coherence across bins is the classical “phasiness” of the phase vocoder, which identity phase locking addresses [ 26 ] .
On the critic side, our multi-period and multi-resolution discriminators come from HiFi-GAN and UnivNet [ 22 , 15 ] and see only waveforms and magnitudes.
EnCodec’s [ 7 ] and DAC’s [ 23 ] discriminators look at complex spectra and split them into bands, and StyleTTS 2 adds a WavLM-based discriminator.
The multi-resolution STFT loss is from Parallel WaveGAN [ 50 ] .
blocks.zh:
Vocos [45] 以帧速率预测出一个全分辨率频谱和相相并用一个iSTFT反相,而iSTFTNet2 [17] 和WaveNEXt [37] 推向相同的方向.
APNet和APNet2 [2,8]和FreeV [34] 明确预测振幅和相位,并使用处理相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相
Wavehax [51] 认为时间频率的vocoders缺乏前调谐器,并添加了前调谐器,这与我们的诊断一致,即小调谐器在前调谐器停止的地方完全失效.
语音阶段的认知重要性是公认的[39],而不同垃圾箱之间相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相
批评者方面,我们的多期和多分辨率歧视者来自HiFi-GAN和UnivNet[22,15],只看到波形和相克.
EnCodec的[7]和DAC的[23]歧视者看复杂的光谱,然后把它们分成了波段,StyleTTS 2增加了一个基于WavLM的区别者.
多分辨率STFT损失出自"平行出浪"GAN [50].

blocks.en:
UTMOS [ 44 ] and its successor [ 4 ] predict MOS well on average, but recent work shows score-preserving degradations that UTMOS does not penalize [ 13 ] and that reference-free metrics do not reliably pick the clip listeners prefer among modern TTS systems [ 3 ] .
Our results are a concrete case.
UTMOS rated one decoder 0.5 lower than another that sounded the same by ear, and it scores audibly buzzy output only 0.13 below the teacher.
blocks.zh:
UTMOS [44] 及其后继 [4] 预测 平均来说,MOS很好,但最近的工作显示,UTMOS并不惩罚[13],没有参考的衡量标准不可靠地选择在现代TTS系统中的剪辑听众偏好[3]。
我们的结果是一个具体的例子。
UTMOS将一个解码器的分数比另一个低0.5分,而这个分数在老师下面只有0.13分。

blocks.en: 9 Limitations
blocks.zh: 9 限制

blocks.en:
Paradee speaks only a single English voice, and we did not train it to speak any other voices or languages.
It can only be as good as its teacher and inherits the teacher’s mispronunciations.
The quality evidence rests on an automatic predictor over 200 sentences and on informal listening by the author, rather than a formal listening test.
Besides the teacher, we compare against only three small open systems, each speaking a different voice.
Speed was measured on one machine only.
Paradee keeps a slight buzz on some voiced sounds, caused by phase and loudness errors in the 2–8 kHz band.
blocks.zh:
游行者只说单一的英语声音,我们没有训练它去说任何其他的声音或语言.
它只能和它的老师一样好并继承老师的发音错误.
质量证据取决于200多句的自动预测器和提交人的非正式倾听,而不是正式的倾听测试。
除了老师之外,我们只比较三个小的开放系统,每个系统讲不同的语音.
只有一台机器测出速度。
游行者对一些已发出的声音保持了轻微的叫声,这些叫声由相位和高音误差在2~8千赫波段所引起.

blocks.en: 10 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 10 结论

blocks.en:
An application that needs one voice does not need most of Kokoro.
Kokoro’s architecture with much narrower layers, its two halves trained separately against the frozen teacher on one laptop, keeps most of its naturalness at a tenth of the parameters and a fifteenth of the compute.
The text side compresses easily.
The difficulty is concentrated in the waveform generator, and specifically in the phase of voiced speech just above the band that the excitation signal covers.
A filter that locks that phase to the model’s own excitation, with no training, removes most of the resulting buzz.
We hope the teacher census, the quantization map and the buzz diagnosis save others the same search.
Code is available at github.com/sahilmahendrakar/paradee , and the model files and audio samples at huggingface.co/sahilmahendrakar/Paradee-8M-v1.0 .
blocks.zh:
一个需要一个声音的应用程序并不需要大部分的克克洛.
Kokoro的建筑层更窄, 其两半分别用一台笔记本电脑对被冷冻的老师进行培训,
文字侧压缩方便.
难度集中在波形生成器上,具体来说是在激起信号所覆盖的波段上方的发音阶段.
如果过滤器将这个阶段锁定在模型本身的刺激上,而不经过任何训练,则可以去除所产生的大多数嗡嗡声。
我们希望师资普查,量化地图 和蜂鸣诊断能救活其他人
代码见:github.com/sahilmahendrakar/paradee,模型文件和音频样本见:huggingface.co/sahilmahendrakar/Paradee-8M-v1.0.

blocks.en: Appendix A DTW log-mel distance
blocks.zh: 附录A DTW 对数-熔相

blocks.en:
The distance is the mean absolute difference between RMS-normalized log-mel spectrograms after dynamic-time-warping alignment, so a rendition that is slightly faster or slower is not penalized for timing alone.
It is not gain-invariant without RMS normalization.
The ONNX export of the teacher is 1.44 × \times louder than the PyTorch package, which at first showed up as a 0.69 gap.
Table 6 gives reference points on the same 5 sentences.
Two renditions at 0.39 could not be told apart by ear, and one at 0.94 sounded close to the teacher but slightly odd in places, so audible differences begin somewhere between about 0.4 and 0.9.
blocks.zh:
距离是RMS-正态的log-mel光谱在动态-时间-战平相接后的平均绝对相差,因此一个稍快或较慢的递解单对时间不进行惩罚.
不使皇家武器正常化,就不会有增益。
教师的ONNX导出比PyTorch包要响亮1.44 ×\时,起初显示为0.69个缺口.
表6列出了同5个句子的参考点。
两起0.39的引渡无法用耳朵分辨出来,一起0.94的引渡听起来接近老师,但地点略为奇怪,因此在大约0.4到0.9之间的某地开始出现明显的差异.

blocks.zh: 表6: 距离测量的参考点。

blocks.en: Appendix B Quantization sensitivity of the teacher
blocks.zh: 附录B 教师的量化敏感性

blocks.en:
We quantized the weights of one part of Kokoro at a time, keeping activations in fp32, and measured the change in the output with the distance of Appendix A (Table 7 ).
Sensitivity runs opposite to size.
The decoder’s convolutional blocks, 41% of the parameters, are unchanged at 8 bits and change little at 4 bits.
The text side changes more at 8 bits, because a nudged duration moves every later frame.
Quantizing all weights to 8 bits shifts durations by 25 ms on average.
The prebuilt dynamic-int8 ONNX file, which also quantizes activations, shifts them by 65 ms and doubles the distance.
All weights in fp16 are indistinguishable from fp32.
blocks.zh:
我们一次量化了Kokoro一个部分的重量,将活化量保持在fp32中,并用附录A的距离测量出输出的变化(表7).
灵敏相去相去.
解码器的演化块,41%的参数,在8位上不变,在4位上变化不大.
文本侧面在8比特时会多变化,因为一个被冲动的时长会移动后方框.
将所有分量量化为8比特,平均班次为25ms.
预建活性-int8 ONNX文件,它也将活性化,移出65 ms并加倍相距.
fp16中的所有重量都与fp32无法区分.

blocks.en: Table 7: Quantizing the weights of one part of Kokoro at a time, with the rest at full precision (8-bit per channel, 4-bit in groups of 64, 4-bit per channel). Each value is the DTW log-mel distance from the full-precision teacher on 5 sentences. Lower is better, and 0.09, the teacher’s difference from its own second run, means no real change. The 0.4M projection after ALBERT is not quantized on its own. Snake activation parameters are kept in fp32, because quantizing them rounds small values to zero and produces NaNs.
blocks.zh: 表7:一次对克克洛某地的重量进行定量,其余部分完全精准(每道8位,每道64个组4位). 每个值是5个句子上与全精度老师的 DTW log-mel相距. 下调更好,而0.09,老师与自己的第二跑的区别,意味着没有真正的变化. ALBERT之后的0.4M投影没有自行定量. 蛇活化参数被保存在fp32中,因为将它们分解为小值至零并产生NaNs.
